environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed as a Kubernetes pod in the 'userdata' namespace. The pod runs with a standard Envoy sidecar (Istio 1.19) but the mesh is configured in PERMISSIVE mTLS mode with no AuthorizationPolicy resources applied. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service on port 3000. Any pod in any namespace can reach /internal/* endpoints directly. No network policies are applied to the namespace.
